title: Erdtree Tower
subtitle: ERDTREE TOWER
tagline: Choose a path. Take an oath. Ascend.
tips: Paths and Choices
Check your supplies before choosing a route. Elites and shops each have their value.
Take an Oath
Every oath has benefits and a price. Read both before choosing.
Weapon Preferences
Upgrade preferences in the Journey Archive for up to five times the selection weight.
Your Build
Check ember stacks and bonuses in the build panel to plan your growth.
Class Legacy
View class mastery and starting talismans at Roundtable Hold.
Armor Transmog
Mix and match appearances freely. Defense still comes from your equipped armor.
Affixes and Skills
Rarity is only part of a weapon. Choose affixes and skills that suit your playstyle.
Challenge the Merchant
Defeating a merchant has a 30% chance to summon a Bell Bearing Hunter.
Moonlight Spring
Choose one: restore HP, restore FP, or take 800 runes.
Scarab Hunt
Each attempt costs 500 runes. You can try up to three times at each event.
Mystery Boxes and Reforging
Find new equipment in mystery boxes, or reforge your right-hand weapon's affixes.
Fellow Travelers
Before co-op, make sure everyone uses the same mod, resource, and Seamless versions.
